services.name: Fishing, Outdoor Charters & Tours
services.desc: Charter fishing for salmon and halibut is always mixed with awesome sightseeing adventure. Beautiful sunrises, singing reels and the smell of fresh salt air. We can always fish in the sheltered waters of Esperanza Inlet and the weather typically lets us venture offshore from the beautiful and rugged west coast of Vancouver Island to fish offshore reefs and the hotspots of the Salmon Highway. Join Captain Norm on his 29-foot Striper for the experience of a lifetime. Fully guided West Coast sportfishing out of Zeballos. Experience world-class angling for various species including Salmon, Lingcod, Rockfish, and Halibut the pristine waters of the Esperanza Inlet. Dirty Worm Sportfishing offers
